actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Swept gray-dark hair, round wire spectacles, dark civilian jacket, pale buttoned shirt and the specifically MAROON BOW TIE are retained. The fine source upper-lip shading was not inflated into a bushy moustache or beard. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Release eligibility remains subject to the current independent exclusion audit. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.
